Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner response after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly claims that the search results indicated "Pine Springs, Minnesota as an incorporated city in Washington County, MN." The actual search results provided by the WebSurfer in Step 1 only showed Pine Springs, Texas (in Culberson County) and Pine Springs Preparatory Academy in North Carolina; there was no mention of a Pine Springs in Minnesota. This hallucinated fact led to an incorrect initial conclusion and subsequent confusion in the conversation flow.
